faq.q: What is AI product photo generation?
faq.a: It turns one clear product photo into a new product image for a listing, lifestyle scene, detail view or ad. Review the result before you publish.

faq.q: How does AI product photo generation work?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or describe the image you need, choose a photo type and scene, then generate a square result. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Is there a free way to make AI product photos?
faq.a: There is no free plan listed. Each image uses 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300 and Premium is $63 for 600. Credits work across photos and videos.

faq.q: Are AI product photos good for ecommerce?
faq.a: Yes. Use them for listing, lifestyle and ad images, then check each result against the product you ship before publishing. That review keeps the color, shape and details accurate.

faq.q: What kinds of product photos can I make?
faq.a: Choose clean listing, lifestyle, on-model, close-detail or social ad images. Every result starts with the product photo or description you provide.

faq.q: What are the benefits of using AI product photos?
faq.a: You skip a studio booking, avoid model and prop logistics, and test new backgrounds or scenes from one product photo.

Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use on Amazon, Shopify, social feeds and ads under our terms. That does not make every input photo copyright-free, so start with photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I add a price or logo to the photo?
faq.a: Add prices, offers and logo text in your editor after download. Generated lettering can be wrong, so keep final brand marks and offer details under your control.
